citation.title: Should the restoration of adjacent implants be splinted or nonsplinted? A systematic review and meta-analysis
citation.authors: de Souza Batista VE, Verri FR, Lemos CAA, Cruz RS, Oliveira HFF, Gomes JML, Pellizzer EP

s_design.anchor: SR/meta-analysis of 1 RCT, 7 prospective and 11 retrospective clinical studies (THERAPY SR/MA row, 100, via Step 2 routing)
s_design.evidence_quote: One was an RCT,4 7 were prospective clinical trials,5,19,21,24-26,34 and 11 were retrospective studies.

domains.evidence_quote: this review was registered at the International Prospective Register of Systematic Reviews (PROSPERO) (CRD42017080162).
An electronic search in the PubMed/MEDLINE, Cochrane Library, and Scopus databases was conducted until November 2017.
domains.note: three bibliographic databases (MEDLINE via PubMed, Cochrane Library, Scopus), above the 3b-i threshold of 2; hand-searching of journals is additional and not counted

domains.evidence_quote: 1 study35 was excluded because it did not report information about crestal bone loss, implant survival, or prosthetic complications of splinted and nonsplinted implants.
domains.note: the single full-text exclusion is identified by citation (ref 35) with a specific, checkable reason

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.evidence_quote: the Newcastle-Ottawa scale was used to assess the risk bias of the selected non-RCT studies
domains.note: Cochrane RoB tool for the one RCT and Newcastle-Ottawa for the 18 non-randomized studies, with results reported per study

domains.evidence_quote: The meta-analysis was based on the Mantel-Haenszel and inverse variance methods.
domains.note: M-H and IV pooling with a heterogeneity-driven switch to random effects; implant failure is pooled per implant, as reported by the primary studies

domains.evidence_quote: A software program (Reviewer Manager 5; Cochrane Group) was used for the meta-analysis and to elaborate the funnel plots.

penalties.item: no conflict-of-interest statement anywhere in the text at all
penalties.note: no conflict-of-interest or competing-interest declaration anywhere; read the title-page footnote block (which carries only the funding line naming the Sao Paulo Research Foundation, a public agency, and author affiliations), the end matter after the Conclusions (corresponding author, Acknowledgments, copyright line) and searched for interest / conflict / competing / disclosure / declaration wording including ligature variants. Funding disclosure alone is not a conflict-of-interest statement

penalties.item: clinical trial not prospectively registered (RCTs only)
penalties.note: not an RCT; this is a systematic review

penalties.item: no sample size justification / power analysis
penalties.note: not applicable to a secondary study

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires
penalties.evidence_quote: The mean follow-up was 87.8 months (range = 12-264 months).
penalties.note: mean follow-up of about 7 years supports the implant-survival claim; two included studies ran 12 months, but the review's own text does not flag follow-up length as a limitation

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز ۹۲ از ۱۰۰، باند A، نوع سوال THERAPY.
sources.interpretation_fa: مرور سیستماتیک ثبت‌شده در PROSPERO با جستجوی سه دیتابیس، ارزیابی سوگیری مطالعات و بررسی سوگیری انتشار، و تنها کسر امتیاز از نبود بیانیه تعارض منافع است. بیشتر مطالعات واردشده غیرتصادفی‌اند و شکست در سطح ایمپلنت شمرده شده است. نبود تفاوت در تحلیل استخوان مارژینال و عوارض پروتزی و بقای بیشتر ایمپلنت در رستوریشن اسپلینت، برای تصمیم درباره اسپلینت کردن ایمپلنت‌های مجاور کاربردی است.

s_design.anchor: SR/meta-analysis of RCTs and non-randomized studies (THERAPY SR/MA row, 100, via Step 2 routing)

EMBASE, and Dentistry and Oral Sciences Source)
domains.note: three bibliographic databases (Ovid MEDLINE, EMBASE, Dentistry and Oral Sciences Source), above the 3b-i threshold of 2, plus reference-list and manual journal searches

domains.evidence_quote: Random-effects meta-analyses of the selected studies were applied if the I2 test showed a value of more than 50%

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز ۹۷ از ۱۰۰، باند A، نوع سوال THERAPY.

citation.title: Under pressure: Unraveling the impact of occlusal overload on peri-implant health–A systematic review
citation.authors: Mojaver S, Patel N, Sarmiento H, Fiorellini JP

s_design.anchor: systematic review without meta-analysis of mixed clinical, experimental (in-vitro, FEA, animal) and review literature on occlusal overload as a risk factor for peri-implant disease (ETIOLOGY SR/meta-analysis row, 100)
s_design.evidence_quote: Inclusion criteria encompassed randomized controlled trials (RCTs), cohort studies, case–control studies, experimental investigations, and systematic reviews that investigated the effects of occlusal overload on peri-implant tissues.

domains.note: هیچ پروتکل ثبت‌شده‌ای (PROSPERO یا هر رجیستری دیگر) و هیچ پروتکل از پیش منتشرشده‌ای در متن نیست؛ بخش‌های خوانده‌شده: پاراگراف آغازین Methods و سؤال PICO، Search strategy، Inclusion and exclusion criteria، Data extraction، Quality assessment، Data synthesis، Sensitivity analysis، Publication bias، Ethical considerations، Results، بخش محدودیت‌های Discussion، Acknowledgments و Conflict of interest statement. واژه‌های register/registration/PROSPERO/protocol جستجو شد و protocol فقط در معنای پروتکل بارگذاری یا پروتکل‌های اکلوزالی آمده است؛ پیروی از PRISMA جای ثبت پروتکل را نمی‌گیرد.

domains.evidence_quote: A systematic search was conducted across PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library for studies published between January 2000 and October 2023.
domains.note: چهار پایگاه داده جستجو شده و از آستانه‌ی دو پایگاه بالاتر است؛ محدودیت زبان انگلیسی و ناهمخوانی بازه‌ی جستجو (۲۰۰۰ تا ۲۰۲۳) با بازه‌ی معیار ورود (۲۰۱۰ تا ۲۰۲۵) در تفسیر آمده است، نه در این رتبه.

domains.evidence_quote: Of 160 initially identified references, 80 studies met the inclusion criteria and were analyzed for relevant outcomes.
domains.note: فهرست مطالعات کنارگذاشته‌شده با دلیل هر یک وجود ندارد، اما هر دو شرط 3b-iii برقرار است: (الف) شرح غربالگری با عدد (۱۶۰ رفرنس به ۸۰ مطالعه) همراه با فلوچارت Figure 1، و (ب) معیارهای صریح ورود و خروج در بخش Inclusion and exclusion criteria.

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.evidence_quote: The methodological quality of the included studies was assessed using appropriate tools based on study design.

متاآنالیزی انجام نشده است؛ بخش Data synthesis صراحتاً می‌گوید سنتز روایتی بوده و «No meta-analysis was performed at this time». Methods، Results و جدول‌های ۱ و ۲ خوانده شد: اعداد bone loss و peri-implantitis فقط کنار هم فهرست شده‌اند و هیچ مدل تجمیع، وزن‌دهی یا سنجش ناهمگنی در متن نیست.

fidelity.source_conclusion:
[S1] However, splinted restorations were associated with a decreased rate of implant failure.
[S2] Additional research and clinical trials are necessary to validate and expand on these findings.
[S3] However, more mechanical complications occurred in nonsplinted crowns than splinted ones.
[S4] Future research should prioritize biomechanical-biological interplay and standardized protocols to refine clinical strategies, ensuring implants withstand functional demands while minimizing complications.
[S5] It is also suggested that pterygoid/tuber implants that are splinted with other implants may present higher survival rates than non-splinted implants.
